title: Segmentation of Bovid Dentition Under Imperfect Annotations: A Comparative Study of Convolutional and Attention Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.31052v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Semantic segmentation decomposes an image into distinct mask regions corresponding to different object categories, such as people, cars, signs or buildings. Advances in machine learning (ML) have shifted this task away from traditional rule-based heuristics such as edge detection, towards deep neural networks (DNN) that learn to classify pixels directly. However, semantic segmentation DNNs crucially depend on expertly designed mask targets to learn from, and imperfect or misaligned masks can interfere with a model's ability to learn effectively.   This paper presents a comparative study of segmentation architectures, ranging from convolutional backbones to vision transformers, applied to the B.O.V.I.D. dataset, a corpus of high-resolution bovid dental photographs paired with hand-made segmentation masks not originally designed for ML-based training. translated_title: 不完美标注下的牛科动物牙齿分割：卷积模型与注意力模型的比较研究
translated_abstract: 语义分割将图像分解为对应不同物体类别（如行人、汽车、标志或建筑物）的独立掩码区域。机器学习（ML）的进展使这一任务从传统的基于规则的启发式方法（如边缘检测）转向能够直接学习像素分类的深度神经网络（DNN）。然而，语义分割深度神经网络严重依赖专家设计的掩码目标来进行学习，不完美或未对齐的掩码会干扰模型的有效学习。本文对多种分割架构进行了比较研究，涵盖从卷积骨干网络到视觉变换器，并将其应用于B.O.V.I.D.数据集——一个由高分辨率牛科动物牙齿照片和手工制作分割掩码组成的语料库，这些掩码最初并非为基于机器学习的训练而设计。我们评估了一系列预处理和对齐技术，以缓解由此产生的问题。
tldr: 本文在不完美手工标注的牛科动物牙齿数据集上，比较了从卷积网络到视觉变换器等多种分割架构的表现，并评估了预处理与掩码对齐技术以减轻标注缺陷对模型训练的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper comparatively evaluates segmentation architectures from convolutional backbones to vision transformers on the B.O.V.I.D. dataset with imperfect hand-made annotations, assessing preprocessing and alignment techniques to mitigate annotation flaws.
